title: How a Godly Man Handles Anger Without Losing Himself
caption:
The sin was never the anger.

It's the ten seconds after it hits. Reacting or naming it. Venting or praying first. Burning something down or fixing what's actually wrong.

Be angry and do not sin (Ephesians 4:26). Two different things. Only one of them is optional.

God gave you the anger. He also gave you the pause before you use it.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #selfcontrol #discipline
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
